name: Microgrid restoration stage-complete feedback
aliases: microgrids Microgrid black-start and restoration controls
summary: Confirms the required feedback before the controller advances from the assigned restoration stage.
description: Confirms the required feedback before the controller advances from the assigned restoration stage. Black-start and restoration control coordinates the establishment of an electrical reference and the gradual return of assigned resources and loads. A dead system, an available starting source and a successful load restoration are distinct states.

In a microgrid recovering from a blackout, an available grid-forming source can establish the assigned island reference before compatible generation and eligible load groups are introduced under the validated restoration strategy. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Stage command and observations” at the input and “Stage-complete indication” at the output. Command transmission alone is insufficient.
